events.title: Rogue Bachata Wednesdays
events.venue: Keystone Crescent Members Club, King's Cross N1 9DX

feature.headline: Two bachata classes at the same time
feature.lede: 7:30–8:45pm. Pick the class that fits you. No partner needed.

schedule.title: Beginners Bachata Class
schedule.text: Beginner friendly, for dancers with 0 to 1 year of bachata experience.

schedule.title: Bachata Class for Experienced Dancers
schedule.text: Emphasis on lead and follow, for dancers with more than one year of experience.

feature.note: 9 Caledonian Road, N1 9DX, 2 minutes from King's Cross St Pancras. The entry is the plain door at No. 9.

events.posterAlt: Poster for Rogue Bachata Wednesdays, Wednesday 28 October 2026 at Keystone Crescent, King's Cross N1 9DX: from 7:30pm, Bachata Class, emphasis on lead and follow, for dancers with more than one year of experience, and Bachata Class, beginner friendly, for dancers with 0 to 1 year of bachata experience. Free social from 9pm. £10 plus booking fee.
